name: BOARDROOM
description: A private conversation workspace for saved messages, quoted replies, attachments, and AI teammate preferences.
note: Web v2. Owner access only. Choose your PIN securely on first opening. AI teammates are not connected; paid requests are disabled.

name: StatusPing
caption: Actual browser preview of the shared Android interface.
description: Make room for a daily check-in. Record how you feel, keep trusted contacts close, and set a gentle reminder for your next check-in.
note: Android 7+ · v0.1.0 debug/test APK. This previously published build is separate from newer source work. Local check-ins only; automatic family alerts are not available. Physical-phone validation and store release are pending.

name: View4Real / SightSync
caption: Current View4Real product-page illustration; the download is the earlier SightSync build.
description: Keep your display preferences together, with profiles for reading, work, and evening screen time. View4Real is the next chapter of SightSync.
note: Current View4Real v0.2.1 is source work; no new Windows installer is verified. The available download is legacy SightSync v0.1.0 only. Trusted signing and current Windows-device testing are pending. No Android or iOS installer.

name: MAX-ALPHA
caption: MAX-ALPHA character artwork. AI connection setup is separate.
description: A personal workspace for conversations, ideas, writing, and everyday planning. Connect your chosen AI service or compatible local model.
note: Available in your browser, including Home Screen setup. Native Android, iOS, and Windows installers have not been released.

name: MAX-ZETA
caption: Official MAX-ZETA artwork. Workspace screens stay private.
description: Your private reporting workspace for PMIX analysis, business documents, and assistant-supported work, with owner access controls.
note: v3.61.0 · Build 84. Owner sign-in and access PIN required. Native installers are not available.

name: The Commissary
caption: Actual development interface with demonstration data.
description: A workspace being developed for restaurant and warehouse inventory: organize stock, review counts, and explore voice-assisted workflows.
note: Development prototype. The Android architecture preview is not an installable Android app yet.

name: Questrix
caption: Actual development interface; project mark shown in the card.
description: Create surveys, collect responses, and turn feedback into useful insights. A developing workspace for teams and shareable questionnaires.
note: Web project in development. Opens in Google AI Studio and may require owner sign-in. No native installer has been released.

name: StockPilot
caption: Actual local interface with seeded demonstration data, not live sales.
description: Bring products, suppliers, pricing, and orders into one self-hosted workspace. Review changes before connecting them to your store.
note: Self-hosted web application. Service configuration is required; native installers are not available.

name: JustMyPick
caption: JustMyPick Happy Bag artwork from the current app source. Runtime screenshots are not yet available.
description: Formerly SavvyKin. A shopping-list and price-comparison companion, with the current JustMyPick Android and iOS versions still in development.
note: No new JustMyPick APK or signed iPhone build is verified. The available download is the old SavvyKin v0.36-debug for Android 8+, without the newer changes. A configured local test backend is required for online features; physical-phone testing remains pending.
